snippet.title: Crystal Siege  Debut Trailer 30 sec
snippet.description:
Master the art of Crystal Combat in an ever changing Tower Defense environment

++ ACTIVE COMBAT
Control your avatar and engage head-on with gruesome monsters while summoning defensive towers - or choose to observe the fight from a distance and support your towers with mighty spells. Your best strategy will completely destroy the demonic horde.

++ UNIQUE MAP EVENTS
Investigate the surrounding and use it to your advantage. In the land of Crystal Siege each battlefield is different and unique.  Smash bridges, freeze the water, trigger a mighty avalanche - only if you master each maps quirks and secrets you shall be victorious.

++ EPIC LOOT
Nothing beats proper loot and epic equipment.
Find the best weapons and armor to become a living legend!

Are you up for the task, oh mighty hero of legend?


• Unique blend between TD and RPG
• Responsive and easy to master touch controls
• Spot-on audio-visual experience
• Jaw dropping retina graphics
• Millions of unique items for your hero
• Master over a dozen mighty elemental spells
• Breath taking boss battles
• Unfold an epic story
